name: rebuilt-data
title: Rebuilt Data Views
description: Custom-built data primitives for readable charts and tables in application interfaces.
useWhen: You need a readable data surface that can be composed into an application workflow.
avoidWhen: You need a complete analytics dashboard with domain-specific data behavior.
responsiveBehavior: Tables scroll horizontally when needed and charts preserve their visual hierarchy at narrower widths.
accessibility: Charts include a visible summary and tables retain native row and header semantics.
Color is paired with labels and values rather than carrying meaning alone.

variants.title: Chart
variants.description: A compact data visualization with direct labels, a quiet grid, and a clear primary series.
accessibility: Pair the visual with a text summary or accessible data table.

variants.title: Data table
variants.description: A compact table that uses alignment, spacing, and restrained borders to keep rows scannable.
accessibility: Use scoped column headers and preserve keyboard access for row actions.
